mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_demand_stage ( demand_id, stage_order, episode_to, amount, status, duration_days, duration_hours, release_flag, is_overdue, create_by, created_at ) VALUES
(#{s.demandId}, #{s.stageOrder}, #{s.episodeTo}, #{s.amount}, #{s.status}, #{s.durationDays}, #{s.durationHours}, 0, 0, #{s.createBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, w.title AS work_title FROM sys_demand_stage s LEFT JOIN sys_work w ON w.work_id = s.work_id WHERE s.demand_id = #{demandId} ORDER BY s.stage_order ASC
SELECT s.*, w.title AS work_title FROM sys_demand_stage s LEFT JOIN sys_work w ON w.work_id = s.work_id WHERE s.stage_id = #{stageId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_demand_stage SET status = #{status}, deliverable_desc = #{deliverableDesc}, deliverable_url = #{deliverableUrl}, work_id = #{workId}, submitted_at = NOW(), ai_score = NULL, ai_result = NULL, ai_reviewed_at = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} AND status IN ('pending', 'rejected')

UPDATE sys_demand_stage SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, release_flag = #{releaseFlag}, reviewed_at = NOW(), update_by = #{updateBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} AND status = 'submitted'

UPDATE sys_demand_stage SET status = #{status}, ai_score = #{aiScore}, ai_result = #{aiResult}, ai_reviewed_at = NOW(), reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} AND status = 'ai_reviewing'
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, w.title AS work_title FROM sys_demand_stage s LEFT JOIN sys_work w ON w.work_id = s.work_id WHERE s.status = 'ai_reviewing' ORDER BY s.stage_id ASC

SELECT w.work_id AS workId, w.title AS title, w.summary AS summary, w.work_type AS workType, w.length_type AS lengthType, w.episode_count AS episodeCount, w.word_count AS wordCount, w.status AS workStatus, u.nick_name AS authorName FROM sys_work w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = w.author_id WHERE w.work_id = #{workId} AND w.is_deleted = 0

SELECT c.chapter_id AS chapterId, c.chapter_no AS chapterNo, c.chapter_title AS chapterTitle, c.word_count AS wordCount, CASE WHEN #{episodeTo} IS NULL OR c.chapter_no <= #{episodeTo} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS readable, CASE WHEN #{episodeTo} IS NULL OR c.chapter_no <= #{episodeTo} THEN c.content ELSE NULL END AS content FROM sys_work_chapter c WHERE c.work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY c.chapter_no ASC, c.chapter_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_demand_stage SET started_at = #{startedAt}, due_at = #{dueAt}, is_overdue = 0, update_by = #{updateBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stage_id = #{stageId}
UPDATE sys_demand_stage SET is_overdue = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stage_id = #{stageId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, w.title AS work_title FROM sys_demand_stage s LEFT JOIN sys_work w ON w.work_id = s.work_id WHERE s.demand_id = #{demandId} AND s.started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.status IN ('pending', 'ai_reviewing', 'submitted', 'rejected') ORDER BY s.stage_order ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.*, w.title AS work_title FROM sys_demand_stage s JOIN sys_demand d ON d.demand_id = s.demand_id LEFT JOIN sys_work w ON w.work_id = s.work_id WHERE d.status = 'in_progress' AND s.started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.status IN ('pending', 'rejected') AND (s.extend_status IS NULL OR s.extend_status <> 'pending') AND s.due_at IS NOT NULL AND s.due_at < NOW() AND s.stage_order = ( SELECT MIN(s2.stage_order) FROM sys_demand_stage s2 WHERE s2.demand_id = s.demand_id AND s2.started_at IS NOT NULL AND s2.status IN ('pending', 'ai_reviewing', 'submitted', 'rejected') ) ORDER BY s.stage_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_demand_stage SET due_at = #{dueAt}, is_overdue = 0, update_by = #{updateBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stage_id = #{stageId}

UPDATE sys_demand_stage SET extend_status = 'pending', extend_days = #{days}, extend_hours = #{hours}, extend_reason = #{reason}, extend_applied_at = NOW(), update_by = #{updateBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stage_id = #{stageId}
mapper.select: SELECT work_id AS workId, title, status, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_work WHERE author_id = #{authorId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status <> 'on_shelf' ORDER BY update_time DESC
